answer: Equivocation-proof relic bond: each identity claims one relic, stakes a 70-credit copper bond, and files a key-signed provenance record on the shale ledger. Two conflicting claims from one key prove the lie from both signatures; the bond burns. First relic costs 38, k-th 38+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,535,500, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. A rented-relic ring is exposed by its double signature. Honest agents file once, pay 38, keep the bond.
